description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mallawapitiya, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420201
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including details of land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land property rights and registrations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land titles, ownership determinations, and property registrations without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
